record.label: Affine-radial all-orders replacement gate
record.summary: With independent affine Gaussian and quadratic radial blocks, the exact reset is an expectation of the arc-cosine kernel at C(s)=L+sQ. Heterogeneous affine/quadratic fractions can produce a broad O(n^2) correction, but the leading jet is H4/Q24-owned and the all-orders tail begins later.
record.terminal_criterion: Prove the independence/operator-isotropy premise, subtract the old jet, and show the exact radial tail has goal-scale endpoint value with controlled third directional derivative.
record.goal_path_summary: Atomic theorem or gate; no sibling inherits this status or evidence.
